reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 12 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution face/moustache and returned-note crops, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The source is near-frontal with only a slight turn toward image right and a forward gaze. The return rotates the head conspicuously toward image left with a leftward gaze and strongly asymmetric eye exposure. Restore the source near-frontal slight image-right orientation and forward gaze.

The source note has compact existing upper gray marks and a small dark right-edge tab. The return invents a dark metal clip/slot across the note's upper edge and adds a third lower signature-like gray-mark row below the two main rows. Remove the clip and added lower row, restoring only the source's compact upper-mark footprint and largely blank lower paper.
entries.positive_observation: The light grey-khaki cap, dark visor, pale piping/cord and silver-white front eagle remain. Dark eyebrows are visible, and the face has one small dark upper-lip moustache with a smooth clean-shaven chin and no beard or glasses; the moustache has not been expanded into jaw/cheek hair. One closed mouth, khaki-olive uniform, pale metallic collar/shoulder details and a short broad fitted collar remain. The complete dark tilted frame and opaque pale warm grey-beige photographic backing remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The changed head orientation and added note content are the clear rejection reasons above.
entries.visible_limitations: Cap-eagle feather detail, tiny collar/shoulder symbols, the precise moustache edge and note lettering are not reliably readable at 65x67. No extra cap-detail or beard rejection is claimed from those uncertainties. The head-turn change and added clip/lower note row are clearly visible.
